newsitem.title: UK: Prudential Corp H1 sales rises worldwide.
newsitem.headline: Prudential Corp H1 sales rises worldwide.

text.p: British insurance group Prudential Corporation Plc announced on Wednesday strong sales growth in its businesses around the world in the first six months of 1997.
Its single premium life, pension and investment product sales grew 23 percent to 3.6 billion stg while its regular premium sales was up 20 percent to 294 million stg.
Prudential's group chief executive Peter Davis described the results as "excellent" and said the group was enjoying sales growth in all its major operations around the world.
Its single premium sales grew 15 percent in the UK to 1.8 billion stg while regular premiums rose 16 percent to 182 million stg.
Prudence Bond, Prudential's best selling product in the UK, reported sales growth of 47 percent at 539 million stg.
Its U.S. subsidiary Jackson National Life witnessed single premium sales growth of 43 percent to $2.4 billion while its annuity sales grew 71 percent to $1.7 billion.
